mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies around Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 88 degrees, a heat index of 96, and an air quality index of 55.

The City Clerk's office is currently preparing for public voting on the I Voted sticker contest, which runs from July 28 through August 7, while the Public Works department reminds residents to inspect their mailboxes for winter plow season readiness.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga sessions at Insight Wellness happening tomorrow.
Reviewing the weekly police logs, on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for a first offense O-W-I after his vehicle became immobilized on a large rock.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful OREO Cookie Overload. The restaurant remains open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab your scoop.
